objective: Emit one public-safe final Primary Chat rich response only after four distinct durable candidate RETURNs and two distinct durable exam RETURNs exist for the same request.

selection.rule: Two independent exam rankings are combined with deterministic Borda scoring; highest score wins, then lower candidate ordinal breaks exact ties.
selection.candidate_payload: Only the selected candidate's already-public-safe rich_response fields are projected; unknown/raw fields are dropped.

forbidden: synthesizing from prepared cards without durable RETURNs
counting duplicate worker_ids or return_refs as independent
claiming more workers than durable evidence proves
truth_boundary: This compiler proves safe deterministic fan-in mechanics. Fixture execution does not claim that a live human request already received four candidate and two exam RETURNs.
